blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Isabella Tabanas gets her first taste of playing a top-flight professional tournament when she joins fellow ICTSI-backed amateurs Lisa and Mona Sarines in the Kenda Tire Cup that tees off on Wednesday at Taichung International Country Club in Taichung, Taiwan. The NT$4-million championship, the 16th leg of the LPGA of Taiwan Tour, is co-sanctioned by the Ladies Philippine Golf Tour and brings together the leading players from the LPGT and a strong international field. For the 16-year-old Tabanas, however, the 54-hole event represents more than just another tournament–it marks her maiden appearance on the TLPGA, giving the promising Cagayan de […]...
